About Rebel

Meet Connor

Rebel Detail & Valeting is Connor's business. When you book, you're booking the person who'll be on your drive and working on your car.

How Rebel started

Connor loves cleaning cars. Rebel started as a hobby, cleaning cars for friends and family, and grew into a full-time business. It's still family run. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: optional: the year Rebel started. The old website said 2020.]

How Connor works

Connor does every job himself, so the person you speak to when you book is the person who turns up. He points out any stains or marks that are unlikely to come out before he starts. If you're at home, he walks round the car with you when it's finished.
